review.notes: All three weighted objective groups and their July 22, 2026 bullets are mapped to administrative responsibility boundaries, worked request/evidence flows, an objective drill, six labs, and eight checks. The repaired coverage explicitly teaches Purview Data Explorer and the Agent Builder create, test, private-by-default, approval, and distribution boundaries. All 39 cited URLs are cataloged: 36 reachable and three O'Reilly/Udemy pages access-blocked; none are missing. The September 7 watch separates Agent 365 product GA from capability rollout and adds the Copilot release feed. September 17, 2026 lifecycle check: added the announced October revision and current date evidence to the guide and catalog. This is a bounded notice update; historical objective snapshot and full-review date remain unchanged. See docs/research/2026-09-17-exam-validation.md.

findings.title: Future live blueprint must not replace current baseline early
findings.evidence: October 14 revision is live with minor application wording change and unchanged weights.
findings.recommendation: Map 53 future objectives and preserve July snapshots/effective date.
findings.resolution: Map 53 future objectives and preserve July snapshots/effective date.

findings.title: Restricted group membership is an additional gate
findings.evidence: Current docs require both ordinary content permission and allowed-group membership; private/shared channel sites need separate policies.
findings.recommendation: Add three-person access example and explicit channel-site boundary.
findings.resolution: Add three-person access example and explicit channel-site boundary.

findings.title: PAYG budget notifies but does not cap spending
findings.evidence: Setup guide says service continues after budget is exceeded and disablement can take up to two hours for active use.
findings.recommendation: Replace conditional wording with exact budget behavior and synthetic overrun example.
findings.resolution: Replace conditional wording with exact budget behavior and synthetic overrun example.

findings.title: Scheduling UI disablement is not execution cancellation
findings.evidence: August 2026 control uses Connected Experiences; existing prompts can continue, past sessions persist and legacy prompts have a different management surface.
findings.recommendation: Add runtime-specific lifecycle example and verification steps.
findings.resolution: Add runtime-specific lifecycle example and verification steps.

findings.title: Scheduled-prompts environment has fixed governance
findings.evidence: Ordinary tenant/environment DLP customization does not apply and deleting the environment does not prevent recreation.
findings.recommendation: Teach special environment boundary rather than maker-environment assumptions.
findings.resolution: Teach special environment boundary rather than maker-environment assumptions.

findings.title: Agent and source-file grants have separate lifecycles
findings.evidence: Removing an agent user does not remove separately shared file permissions; sharing-policy restrictions do not revoke existing access.
findings.recommendation: Add two-path revocation example and existing-grant inventory.
findings.resolution: Add two-path revocation example and existing-grant inventory.

findings.title: An unapproved update leaves the approved version usable
findings.evidence: Current request guidance preserves the earlier agent while an update awaits approval.
findings.recommendation: Require separate version review and containment decisions.
findings.resolution: Require separate version review and containment decisions.

findings.title: MCP registration does not imply support in every client
findings.evidence: Current BYO preview excludes declarative agents and Foundry in this particular integration flow.
findings.recommendation: Add supported-client and preview boundary without creating a general MCP prohibition.
findings.resolution: Add supported-client and preview boundary without creating a general MCP prohibition.
